role: Checks a company profile against real grant/funding program eligibility criteria, reporting every failing criterion (not just the first), and flags urgent deadlines using the same real threshold concept as E-02's Chief of Staff.
behaviorDescription: matchPrograms() checks a real company profile against every real program's criteria (age range, sector, region, incorporation, funding amount range) and reports every failing reason, not just the first — verified against real match and multi-mismatch cases before implementation. Flags eligible programs with a deadline within 14 days as urgent, reusing the same threshold concept as E-02's Eisenhower classification. No LLM call needed — real, deterministic multi-criteria matching.
hardStops: Never reports only the first failing criterion — every genuine mismatch is reported so the person knows exactly why they don't qualify
Never fabricates eligibility for a program whose criteria genuinely aren't met
Does not force an attribution to a historical 'master' where none genuinely fits — real logic stands on its own
